[[No overall control]]{{efn|Labour minority.}} | after_election = | after_party = }} The '''2026 Tamworth Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 11 of 30 members of [[Tamworth Borough Council]] in [[Staffordshire]], [[England]].{{Cite web |last=mhclgpress |date=2026-02-16 |title=Update on May 2026 local authority elections – MHCLG in the Media |url=https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk |language=en}} ==Summary== ===Background=== In [[2024 Tamworth Borough Council election|2024]], the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] gained majority control of the council.{{Cite web |last=LLoyd |first=Matt |date=2024-05-03 |title=Tamworth council election results in full as Labour win control |url=https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/news/midlands-news/tamworth-council-election-results-full-29110231 |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=Birmingham Live |language=en}}{{Cite news |title=Tamworth result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E07000199 |access-date=2026-02-17 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}} In January 2026, the council asked for the election to be postponed pending local government reorganisation.{{Cite web |date=2026-01-15 |title=Tamworth Borough Council calls for elections to be postponed |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz6y0gjd351o |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}} However it was rescheduled on 16 February 2026.{{Cite web |date=2026-02-16 |title=Government abandons plans to delay 30 council elections |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c70ne31d884o |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=www.bbc.com |language=en-GB}} On 21 April 2026, it was announced that the poll for Wilnecote Ward will be postponed to a later date, following the death of Sian Foster, the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] candidate. The polls in all other wards will be proceeding as planned on the 7th of May.{{Cite web |title=Wilnecote Ward poll to be rearranged due to candidate death {{!}} Tamworth Borough Council |url=https://www.tamworth.gov.uk/wilnecote-ward-poll-be-rearranged-due-candidate-death |access-date=2026-04-23 |website=www.tamworth.gov.uk}}{{Cite web |title=Democracy Club Candidates
